deadline.value: No formal deadline, but applications should arrive by February 1 for full consideration for Fall entry.
deadline.quote: to ensure full consideration for Fall entry applications should be received no later than February 1

gre_general.value: The department says the GRE is not needed for the PhD.
gre_general.quote: GRE requirement is not needed for admission to the PhD program.

gre_subject.value: GRE requirement stated on program page.
gre_subject.quote: GRE requirement is not needed for admission to the PhD program.

toefl_min.value: The department page gives the old-scale TOEFL iBT 79, which predates the January 2026 change; the new-scale value is not confirmed.

ielts_min.value: The department also asks for an IELTS overall band of at least 6.5.
ielts_min.quote: English proficiency can also be met by submitting official IELTS scores of at least 6.5 overall band score

supervisor.value: The catalog does not say whether a faculty member must agree before admission.

funding.value: Qualified students are considered for teaching assistantships with a stipend and full tuition remission for the first two years, not all admitted students.
funding.quote: qualified students will be considered for Graduate Teaching Assistantship (GTA)

entry_route.value: A bachelor's in physics (or a related subject) is enough to start the PhD.
entry_route.quote: The PhD is typically a five-year degree program available to qualified individuals with a bachelor's in Physics from an accredited college or university

notes: Source: the 2026-27 graduate catalog Physics PhD section, also on louisville.edu/programs/physics-phd. The department's own application page (physics.louisville.edu) returned HTTP 502 and was not used.
